current_date: Published following Development Control Committee agreement on 12 December 2024 (no date inside the PDF)
current_evidence: The council's 'Planning validation requirements' page links this document and states 'The current list was published following agreement by Development Control Committee on 12 December 2024'. Bromley also publishes per-application-type checklists at /PlanningChecklists.

issues.detail: List date 2025-09-01 comes from the PDF metadata CreationDate. The PDF text has no date. The council page says the current list was published after Development Control Committee agreement on 12 December 2024, so the list date should be December 2024.
issues.evidence: bromley.gov.uk/planning-applications/planning-validation-requirements: 'The current list was published following agreement by Development Control Committee on 12 December 2024.'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not read Bromley's 16 per-application-type validation checklists (Householder, Full - change of use, Full - new dwellings, LDC existing and proposed, Non-material amendment, s73, Details reserved by condition, and prior approvals for change of use, demolition, larger home extension, upward extensions, telecoms and others). It recorded '(none)' for Householder, LDC, s73, NMA, Discharge of conditions and Change of use prior approval. For example, the Householder checklist requires: Photos (all applications); BNG Exemption Statement (all); CIL Form 1 where the extension is 100 sqm or more; Block Plan where the footprint increases, or for an outbuilding, new boundary treatment or vehicle access; Flood Risk Declaration in Flood Zone 2 or 3 where new footprint is created; Design and Access Statement in a Conservation Area at 100 sqm or more, or with LBC; Tree Survey where trees could be affected; street scene elevations where height increases; sections where floor-to-ceiling or roof heights change or a basement is created.
issues.evidence: bromley.gov.uk/PlanningChecklists lists 16 checklists; Householder checklist (validation-checklists/4): 'Flood Risk Declaration', 'Photos - Mandatory on all applications', CIL Form 1 if 100 sqm or more

issues.detail: The main guidance names application types that Grokbot left as '(none)'. CIL Form applies to full planning including householder, Lawful Development Certificates, and reserved matters following outline. The 'Supporting Statement for Lawful Development Certificates - Outbuildings over 50sqm' applies to LDCs. 'Additional requirements for S96a and S73 amendments' applies to NMAs and s73. Design and Access Statement applies to Listed Building Consent and to one or more dwellings, or 100 sqm or more, in a Conservation Area. Grokbot's '(none)' for Householder, Reserved matters, Lawful development cert, Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment is therefore wrong.
issues.evidence: Guidance Part 1: CIL Form 'Full planning permission (including householder), Lawful Development Certificates, and reserved matters'; 'Additional requirements for S96a and S73 amendments'

issues.detail: 'Floor plans / Elevations' is placed under Advertisement consent, but the quoted source says floor plans are required for all proposals EXCEPT external-only works such as signage. Only elevations apply to proposed signage. 'Block plan / Site plan' is placed under Outline only because the text says 'Site must be outlined in Red'. The Block Plan is required for proposals that increase the built footprint, add buildings, or involve boundary treatments or freestanding signage. It is not specific to outline applications.
issues.evidence: 'Existing and Proposed Floor Plans When Required For all proposed developments except proposals which are only for external works such as boundary treatment or proposed signage.'

issues.detail: Grokbot put about 40 requirements from this general list under Full planning only, each with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named'. Many apply more widely. Tree Survey covers any development affecting trees, including householder. Heritage Statement covers LBC, Scheduled Monument Consent and Conservation Area applications. Photos are required on all applications. Flood risk includes a householder and minor-extension declaration.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'Development affecting the setting of a Listed Building, Listed Building Consent, Scheduled Ancient Monument Consent ... within or adjacent to a Conservation Area'

issues.detail: Many triggers stop at the heading 'When Required' and give no condition. Air Quality: actual trigger is major developments, potentially polluting or traffic-generating sites in an AQMA or AQFA, and uses serving vulnerable groups. Land Contamination: sensitive uses, previous contaminative uses, former landfill, commercial or unknown history. Energy Strategy: major developments. Heritage Statement: see above. Parking: new residential, employment, education and leisure. Roof plans: new buildings, first-floor and two-storey extensions, roof works. Sections: changes to floor-to-ceiling heights, raised roofs, new units. Streetscene: new buildings and height increases. Structural Survey: demolition of statutory or locally listed buildings, Green Belt/MOL conversions, unsafe buildings. Travel Plan: major development. Town Centre/Retail Impact: major development, and non-major changes of use of retail premises. Landscaping: major, new-build residential, external amenity space.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts e.g. 'options. 27 Energy Strategy When Required', 'realm. 48 Travel Plan When Required', 'SPG. 32 Heritage Statement When Required'

issues.detail: Several triggers are text from a neighbouring requirement. 'Transport Assessment' quotes the Planning Obligations heading; the actual trigger is major development and other development affecting the highway network. 'Planning Obligations' quotes the Air Quality heading; actual is major development and certain non-major schemes, e.g. in town centres. 'Daylight/Sunlight' runs into the Delivery and Servicing Plan trigger; actual is major proposals and tall buildings. 'Cycle parking' quotes drawing-dimension guidance. 'Waste / Refuse' quotes landscaping text; actual is new residential including conversions, plus employment, education and leisure. 'Odour/Dust/Vibration' quotes CEMP text. 'Planning Statement' quotes a covering-letter note; actual is major development and proposals raising wide issues, including Green Belt/MOL very special circumstances. 'Housing mix' is the fragment 'of 10% wheelchair user provision.'; actual is the Accessible/Adaptable Homes statement for all new-build residential. 'Advertisement drawings' is the fragment 'intensity of illumination.'. 'Photographs' says 'When photographs are necessary', but Photos are required on all applications and must be taken within 30 days.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Transport row: 'See also Transport Assessment below. 43 Planning Obligations - Draft Heads of Terms When Required'; guidance 'Photos: All applications'

issues.detail: The 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' row is actually the Energy Masterplan requirement: larger-scale major development over 15,000 sqm, excluding housing-only schemes, in Opportunity Areas, Town Centres or growth areas. It is not a design code requirement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Energy Masterplan When Required Larger scale major development ... more than 15,000sqm'

issues.detail: Several environment and safety items are missing. Fire Statement (London Plan): all major development, new dwellings including conversions, commercial development and changes of use. Grokbot only has the Gateway One fire statement. Flood Risk Householder and minor extensions in Flood Zone 2/3 Declaration: extensions with additional footprint up to 250 sqm. Circular Economy Statement: development referable to the Mayor. Whole Life-Cycle Carbon Assessment: applications referable to the Mayor, encouraged for other major schemes. Air Quality Positive Statement: major proposals subject to EIA. Living Roof and Wall Details: proposals including living roofs or walls. Geological Survey Report: on or near a SSSI or regionally important geological site. Urban Greening Factor information: major developments.
issues.evidence: Guidance Part 2 items: 'Fire Statement (London Plan)', 'Flood Risk Householder and other minor extensions in Flood Zone 2/3 Declaration', 'Circular Economy Statement', 'Whole Life-Cycle Carbon (WLC) Assessment'

issues.detail: Other local items are missing. Accommodation Schedule: major residential. Accessible/Adaptable Homes and/or Wheelchair Housing Statement: all new-build residential. Housing Management Plan: build-to-rent, older persons housing, PBSA, large-scale shared living. Construction Logistics Management Plan: major, 5+ new dwellings including change of use, or significant traffic impact. Delivery and Servicing Plan: new commercial uses, as its own item. Landfill and Waste Transfer Statement: waste transfer, treatment or deposit. Landscape / Townscape and Views Impact Assessment: development above the general height, important views, Green Belt/MOL, heritage assets. Materials Schedule: major and complex or sensitive proposals. Public Toilet Management Plan: public-facing schemes over 15,000 sqm. Social Infrastructure Statement: provision or loss of social infrastructure. Supporting Statement for LDC outbuildings of 50 sqm or more. S96a/S73 additional requirements.
issues.evidence: Guidance Part 2 table of contents (Accommodation Schedule, Housing Management Plan, CLMP, Landfill and Waste Transfer Statement, Materials Schedule, Public Toilet Management Plan, Social Infrastructure Statement)
issues.grok_comment: Most of the listed items are absent. But the Accessible/Adaptable Homes and/or Wheelchair Housing Statement is captured as the Full planning row "Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS, accessible homes)". Its trigger ("...of 10% wheelchair user provision") comes from that item, though only in fragment form.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Accessible homes is partly captured under the housing mix row. The other missing items stand.

issues.detail: Most tab items are process, fee or boilerplate text, not requirements. They include the invalid-application Administration Fee rules (5 items), the GDPR personal-data note, 'Please ensure to use our checklists...', the 21-day invalid-application process, and 'Applications can often be invalid ... Metric as PDF instead of Excel'. Others are fragments: 'Please ensure to include ALL key dimensions listed above ... such as: 7', with a page number, and 'Examples of plans - ... GOV.UK ('. The Full planning row 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' ('We therefore strongly encourage pre-application engagement') is advice, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' section; app_type_rows 'Pre-application advice / engagement details'

issues.detail: Some tab items and rows are duplicated. 'Please ensure to include ALL key dimensions listed above...' appears twice. 'Examples of plans ... All plans must be submitted as separate single page PDF files' appears under both Drawing standards and Submission rules. 'Foul Sewage / Utilities' and 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' rows quote the same single item ('Foul Sewage and Surface Water Drainage Assessment'). The 'Sequential / Exception Test' row runs into that same foul sewage text.

summary: Grokbot's link is Bromley's current local list, published after DCC agreement on 12 December 2024. However, Grokbot dated it 2025-09-01 from PDF metadata and never read the 16 per-application-type checklists, so its '(none)' entries for Householder, LDC, s73, NMA and reserved matters are wrong. Many triggers are truncated at 'When Required' or taken from adjacent items, and around 20 local requirements are missing, including the London Plan Fire Statement, the householder flood declaration, Circular Economy, WLC and CLMP.
